text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. These tasks include learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a key part of AI. It allows computers to learn from data and improve over time without being directly programmed. Deep learning, a more advanced form of machine learning, uses artificial neural networks to handle complex problems. AI is already part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask voice assistants questions, get movie recommendations, or use navigation apps. Banks also use AI to detect fraud. AI is changing the way we live and work.
